description: Update the stewardship roster for a previously-donated land parcel. The on-chain LandRegistry NFT is NEVER transferred (per ADR-2605192245 inalienability); only the stewardship voice is rotated. This record is authored by Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land) typically with consent from the outgoing steward(s). Use cases: voluntary withdrawal, incapacitation, named-successor activation, Council-initiated rotation when stewards become unreachable.

donationRef.description: AT URI of the originating `com.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record this succession amends.

previousStewardDids.description: DIDs that held stewardship voice prior to this succession. Inclusive — list all who are being rotated out, in addition to any continuing stewards.

newStewardDids.description: DIDs that hold stewardship voice after this succession. May overlap with previousStewardDids (partial rotation).

reason.description: Single-value enum: 'voluntary-withdrawal' | 'incapacitation' | 'named-successor-activation' | 'council-initiated' | 'donor-passing' | 'other'. The reason must be substantively justifiable to ≥3 Council seats post-bootstrap; founder-attested during bootstrap.

narrative.description: Free-form markdown narrative explaining the context. Used for transparency and Council deliberation; not legally binding.

attestorDid.description: DID of the Council seat (typically Seat 5 Stewardship/Land, or Seat 1 Founder during bootstrap) attesting this succession. Multi-attestation (≥3-of-5 Council post-bootstrap) is recorded via co-equal sibling records under the same at-uri prefix.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this succession was recorded.
